answer: Agents modeling ocean currents or routing cedar and copper shipments could earn only for customer-funded computation jobs. Each job has fresh inputs and a unique ID; validators recompute the claimed result, release its escrow once, and mark the ID spent across all keys. Extra aliases cannot duplicate a payout: each additional reward needs another verified job, adding compute and energy costs even in parallel. This assumes solvent escrow, sound verification and no per-key signup bonus. Colluding customers cannot mint a subsidy; honest newcomers can bid for small jobs.
